title: Inspector Thorne
paragraphs: A short-run detective drama produced by Frank and Anne Hummert, centered on Inspector Thorne's investigations of murder and other serious crimes.
Short NBC sustaining detective series created by Frank and Anne Hummert.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Karl Weber lead era (July 20, 1951 to August 31, 1951) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] and Staats Cotsworth lead era (September 6, 1951 to September 27, 1951) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Dan Ocko (performer), Frank Hummert (creator and author), Fred Collins (announcer), Anne Hummert (creator and author), [[person|karl-weber|Karl Weber]] (performer), Edward Slattery (director), and Kenneth MacGregor (director).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].
The stories often return to police homicide investigation, murder mystery, witness interrogation and clue analysis, NBC sustaining crime drama, and urban crime and social motives.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Eleven-broadcast Inspector Thorne run, Lead transition from Karl Weber to Staats Cotsworth, September move from Friday to Thursday, and Inspector Thorne NBC launch.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|x-minus-one|X Minus One]], [[show|dimension-x|Dimension X]], [[show|the-mysterious-traveler|The Mysterious Traveler]], [[show|words-at-war|Words at War]], and [[show|cbs-radio-mystery-theater|CBS Radio Mystery Theater]].
